title: Rebranding and communication for Selfish, reinforcing its positioning
description:
Rebranding and communication for Selfish, reinforcing its positioning

Selfish is one of the brands within the Starfoods group, with its own positioning in the restaurant industry, focused on fish, freshness, and flavor.

At LV, we recently supported the brand through a refresh process aimed at clearly reinforcing the freshness of its fish. The work included updating the visual identity, simplifying the brand language, and strengthening its positioning, making the brand more contemporary, direct, and aligned with its audience.

We maintained the irreverence that has always defined Selfish, but introduced a cleaner, more confident, and consistent image, elevating the perception of quality and authenticity.

Today, Selfish operates in two distinct formats:– the shopping mall version, faster and more functional– and the Selfish with a Twist concept, located at Freeport Alcochete, offering a more experiential and differentiated approach.

title: Take Yourself Funny For Money
description: Comic Relief kicked off its Red Nose Day 2026 campaign, Take Yourself Funny For Money, with a one-night-only projection of celebrities’ cringeworthy ‘Best Worst Photos’ onto Battersea Power Station. Developed and launched by Ogilvy UK, the campaign is inviting people to embrace Britain’s self-deprecating sense of humour by sharing their own awkward snaps with the hashtags #BestWorstPhoto and #rnd26 on social media.Claudia Winkleman’s smudged eyeliner look at the 2013 GQ awards and Miranda Hart’s infamous school photo lit up the iconic Battersea Power Station, alongside other national treasures Davina McCall, Big Zuu and La Voix, which Ogilvy UK collaborated with immersive digital experience specialist Pixel Artworks to execute. Branded content was also displayed in Manchester’s flagship entertainment complex Printworks.The PR stunt is now being amplified through hashtag-driven user-generated content and PR across national and broadcast media, drawing mass awareness to the beginning of Comic Relief's legendary fundraising campaign which will culminate on Red Nose Day, Friday 20th March 2026.Ogilvy UK was appointed Comic Relief’s creative and strategic partner for Red Nose Day 2026 following a competitive pitch last spring. The agency was briefed to create an attention-grabbing ‘big idea’ that would serve as a hero moment for the launch of the fundraising campaign.Samir Patel, CEO, Comic Relief:“Nothing brings people together quite like laughter, especially when we’re laughing at ourselves. We’re kicking off the campaign this year with a fun, silly and simple way to get involved, inviting the public to post their own #BestWorstPhoto, to help us build the energy and excitement as we ramp up to Red Nose Day on Friday 20 March.”Jules Chalkley, Chief ECD, Ogilvy UK, says:“One night, one landmark and a few laughs at the willing expense of celebs. By making the campaign purpose-built for capturing, sharing and participating across social media, last night’s spectacle will once again cement Comic Relief firmly in the nation’s hearts and drive awareness of a fundraising campaign that helps to change and saves lives. Charlie Coney, Creative Strategy Officer, adds: “We’ve all got a photo we’re embarrassed about - AND laugh about. After all, self-deprecating humour is what makes Brits, British. Rather than a traditional launch for Comic Relief’s fundraising campaign, we wanted an irresistible bit of cultural theatre. What better way to take yourself funny for money?"

title: Every Journey Starts Somewhere
description:
In an era of high-decibel brand activations, Audi UK and BBH London are betting on the power of the unsaid for the 2026 BRIT Awards.

Music and automotive culture share a natural moment: the start of a journey. Great bands, artists and journeys often start in the same place - the garage. A humble space where musicians find their rhythm, tune their instruments, and take the first steps toward something extraordinary. It’s where rhythm is found, and where engines are tuned.

By highlighting this shared origin, BBH connects the BRITs and Audi UK in a way that feels authentic, iconic, and culturally fluent. Because every great journey starts somewhere.

Tony Moore, Head of Marketing at Audi UK said: “This campaign celebrates the shared philosophy of Audi and the BRITs: that every great performance begins with dedication, practice, and attention to detail. By showing rather than telling, it captures our partnership in a way that feels natural, culturally fluent, and unmistakably Audi.”

Set at night, the scene is a quiet garage bathed in moody, cinematic lighting. The night-time atmosphere adds intimacy and focus, letting the audience pause, lean in, and absorb the parallels between the journeys of music and automotive. There’s no headline, no explanation, no dramatic call-to-action. Just the Audi and BRITs logos. It’s confident, understated, and unmistakably Audi, proving that sometimes the most impactful storytelling is the one the audience completes themselves.

title: ScrollSticks
description:
For many, eating and scrolling on their phone are activities that go hand in hand. In fact, the survey unveiled that almost all Americans (96%) have used their phone while eating, and 66% of Americans use their phones often while eating at least one of their daily meals, according to a new study by Angus Reid commissioned by bibigo™ .

That’s why bibigo created ScrollSticks - chopsticks featuring a custom dual-ended design, with one side for enjoying your meal, and the other has touchscreen tips for scrolling.The re-imagined chopsticks are born from foodie behaviour and developed with multitasking consumers in mind to allow audiences to snack and scroll — without the mess.

title: Forever Sweethearts
description:
This Valentine’s Day, Zales is blending nostalgia with jewelry in a playful new campaign that puts the focus on self-love, Forever Sweethearts by Zales. Developed in partnership with its agency of record, Anomaly, the brand has partnered with iconic candy Sweethearts® to create a limited-edition collection that transforms the classic candies into wearable keepsakes: a 10k yellow gold heart charm, featuring lab-grown diamonds, engraved with one of three classic Sweethearts® messages: OOO LA LA, AMORE, or XOXO.

The charms were available for purchase on Zales.com - and sold out within 27hrs of launching. The 10k Yellow Gold heart-shaped charms were boxed in a Sweethearts®-inspired package, echoing the familiar candy packaging, and featured a surprise message inside - true to the element of surprise that makes the candies so beloved.

The blind-box format was encouraging to self-gifters, inviting consumers to treat themselves to a “sweetheart” they can keep forever. The campaign leveraged the nostalgia of Sweethearts® candies and the emotional power of jewelry to create a playful, memorable experience. The campaign expands on Zales’ ‘Own It’ platform, empowering consumers to celebrate themselves daily. The work is live now across owned channels and paid social with influencer support

title: 2026 Valentine’s Day campaign
description:
Since 1837, Tiffany & Co. has celebrated the world’s greatest love stories through cinematic storytelling, meaningful design and exceptional craft. In its 2026 Valentine’s Day campaign, the House offers a poignant narrative around joy, human connection and the strength love affords us. The film is directed by Justyna Obasi, an Emmy ® -nominated commercial and music video director represented by Love Song, and stars actress Adria Arjona. Tiffany’s exceptional craft becomes a lens for storytelling, a narrative where love lives in the small details that make it real. Love takes strength, and HardWear from Tiffany is a beautiful expression of this spirit.

Honoring the strength of that bond with a gift that embodies the myriad qualities of love, several HardWear pieces are at the center of Tiffany & Co.’s 2026 Valentine’s Day campaign. Equally intimate and genuinely romantic, the film grounds itself in a couple who engage in an irreverent bit in which they meet again as married strangers, with the man lovingly describing his wife, played by Arjona, as she sits across from him. Obasi directs this film with delicate choreography to accentuate the actors’ natural instincts, making the on-screen relationship feel palpably real.

Radiating elegant simplicity, the story elevates the beautiful craft behind Tiffany & Co.’s iconic HardWear collection. A cinematic experience made up of organic moments, genuine chemistry and striking visuals, the House’s 2026 Valentine’s Day campaign is a love letter to the real, complex and enduring commitment of truly loving someone.

“A good love story isn’t one note; it’s multifaceted and layered,” said director Justyna Obasi. “There’s humor, patience and vulnerability, and ultimately, inner strength, the facet of love that HardWear represents. We wanted to show how this strength translates within a relationship.”

title: Chew Bold
description:
Stimorol launches new “Chew Bold” brand platform with film starring a boxing sloth.

Perfetti Van Melle chewing gum brand, Stimorol, is targeting Gen-Zers with a new platform, “Chew Bold.” Created by AMV BBDO, the platform launches with a film of a boxing sloth, directed by Emmy-winning and Grammy-nominated director Jake Scott at RSA.

Inspired by Gen Z’s belief that you don’t need to blend in to belong, “Chew Bold” encourages audiences to be confident, carefree and true to yourself, no matter who you’re with or where you are.

The “Chew Bold” platform is embodied by the sloth who stars in the launch film. Not fitting the stereotype of a fitness fiend, he’s working the speedbag like a pro. Having finished his workout, he cooly nods at curious gymgoers and nonchalantly saunters to the door. As our sloth leaves the gym it’s revealed he is actually human 20-something who Chews Bold and doesn’t need to blend in to belong.

“Chew Bold” marks a key milestone in Perfetti Van Melle’s ongoing strategic investment in growing and modernising its gum portfolio and is the first major new brand campaign and platform for Stimorol since Perfetti Van Melle took ownership of the brand in late 2023 as part of its acquisition of Mondelēz International’s gum business in the US, Canada and Europe.

title: Smell Like Your Ex(foliating Body Wash)
description:
Suave has launched Smell Like Your Ex(foliating Body Wash), a new social-first campaign created in partnership with global social-first creative agency Born Social. The push supports the launch of Suave’s new exfoliating body wash collection, marking the 89-year-old brand’s inaugural social-first campaign.

The campaign signals a clear evolution in Suave’s marketing playbook to social- and culture-first storytelling to power the launch of its newest Exfoliating Body Wash. The work spotlights the brand’s commitment to quality and accessibility, bringing Suave’s There’s More To It positioning to life within this fast-growing product category.

Built on a cultural insight gleaned from social listening, the campaign plays into the shared experience of exes and the lingering clothing and scent that instantly brings old relationships back to life. The central idea encourages letting go of your ex - starting with their hoodie - and replacing it with a scent that’s actually worth keeping. It sits at the intersection of emotional baggage, Gen Z’s interests in thrift culture, and the exfoliating, scent-led benefit of the product. The thrift concept also nods to Suave’s long-standing focus on everyday affordability.

“This campaign marks an important moment for Suave as we launch our new exfoliating body wash collection and take a modern approach to connecting with Gen Z by hacking into their feeds through entertainment,” said Tina Ghory, Senior Director, Consumer Engagement at Suave. “Smell Like Your Ex(foliating Body Wash) reflects how we’re evolving as a brand and showing up differently, speaking the language of this audience and bringing our There’s More To It positioning to life in a way that feels relevant, accessible and native to social.”

The campaign launches with a hero social film and three vignettes set inside a local thrift store called The Ex-Change. Shot like a throwback, homemade thrift-store commercial, the film follows a deadpan store representative as she wanders the aisles addressing the camera. Customers line up clutching items left behind by their exes, from stained overalls to oversized novelty items, as tongue-in-cheek sections categorize different “ex” archetypes. The film culminates with a customer trading in her ex’s hoodies and receiving a fresh hoodie and Suave Exfoliating Body Wash, ending on a knowingly awkward product reveal that positions the body wash as an empowered upgrade to smelling like your ex.

description:

description:

There’s something special about the way a juicy cooked-to-order steakburger, crispy fries, or freshly churned frozen custard can make time itself feel like it’s standing still. 3Headed Monster’s new campaign for Freddy’s captures that feeling, literally, creating a world where time slows as guests savor every bite, every laugh, and every second together. Because at Freddy’s, the good stuff isn’t just the food… it’s the moments you take to enjoy it.

title: Dirt Road
description:
If you’ve turned on network or cable TV in the last few months, you’ve likely witnessed the ongoing Clash of the Carriers between AT&T and T-Mobile. The two brands have been lobbing a steady stream of confusing, convoluted ads at one another — staged on dusty dirt roads — all in service of a familiar, cliche contest: comparing whose network is bigger.

But judging by the lawsuit filed between the companies, the only thing the dirt has been good for is something they can drag one another through.

In an era when nationwide coverage should be a given, smart consumers know these campaigns are just a distraction from what really matters: great coverage at low prices, backed-up by industry-leading customer service.

Consumer Cellular launched a very different kind of salvo with a Super Bowl spot this past Sunday that shifts the focus away from coverage chest-thumping and toward service — the thing customers interact with long after the signal bars fade from view. To make the point, they also found a nice dirt road to shoot the aptly titled, “Dirt Road” on, just so everyone would know they’re watching a wireless carrier spot.

The difference is who’s doing the talking. Rather than a celebrity or a scripted pitchman, they asked a conveniently named real store manager, Rhine Reynolds, to explain why Consumer Cellular stands out. More on Mr. Reynolds coming soon.

title: Fans Have More Friends
description:
Heineken® this week launches Fans Have More Friends, a new global sponsorship platform built on the belief that fandom is one of the quickest ways to spark a connection between strangers.

Rooted in Heineken®’s long-standing belief in the importance of sociability, and inspired by the book of the same name (Fans Have More Friends) by Ben Valenta and David Sikorjak, the platform reflects how shared passions help people connect naturally. It’s the first time Heineken® is bringing together its sponsorships across football, Formula 1® and music festivals, using fandom as both a social catalyst and a way to elevate social experiences in a world that can feel increasingly lonely.

New research commissioned by Heineken® shows that three-quarters (75%) of fans say their fandom has helped them meet new people, making it one of the fastest ways to create bonds at a time when many people are missing IRL connections more than ever before.

Three in five (59%) say it's helped them forge some of their closest friendships and 75% say watching sports with other fans, even if they're not fans of the same team, makes the experience better. Football topped the list as one of the greatest social connectors with 72% of fans saying language is not a barrier when it comes to making football mates in a bar.

To put the findings to the test, Heineken® partnered with Zac Alsop to carry out a social experiment designed to test whether fans would really show up for one another when it mattered. The experiment followed Joe, an Australian living in New York, who found himself without anyone to watch Liverpool play Qarabağ FK in the final group match of the UEFA Champions League. Like many people, despite having a life and routine in a big city, he was facing the prospect of watching one of football’s biggest nights alone.

title: 'Someday Starts Today
description:
As housing decisions feel harder to make, whether buying, renting or planning what comes next, Zillow® is evolving how it shows up as a brand. The company is launching "Someday Starts Today," a new national platform, campaign and tagline designed to support people at every stage of the home journey, from those ready to move now to those still only imagining what's possible.

The campaign debuts Feb. 1 in connection with Zillow advertising that airs during the Grammy Awards broadcast, and it reflects a strategic expansion of Zillow's brand approach. Rather than focusing only on moments of transaction, the approach is designed to resonate across the full home journey, supporting people who are actively moving today while also building belief and confidence among future movers who may be browsing, dreaming or planning what comes next.

"Everyone's home journey looks different, but progress is what moves it forward," said Beverly W. Jackson, vice president of brand and product marketing at Zillow. "'Someday Starts Today' reflects our commitment to meet people where they are and recognize every step forward, because even small progress matters."

Speaking to the in-between momentAffordability challenges and economic uncertainty have reshaped how people approach housing, stretching the time between moves and changing consumer behavior. While some consumers are actively buying, renting or selling, millions of people use Zillow every day to scroll listings, compare rentals, track home values and save ideas long before they're ready to make a move.

"Someday Starts Today" is designed to speak to that in-between moment. The campaign reframes browsing, planning and dreaming as meaningful parts of the home journey — not passive behavior, but early signals of intent that build over time. Zillow believes that for many future movers, their "someday" may be closer than they think.

title: GP Access – Tap it, type it and we’ll take care of it
description:
GP Access – Tap it, type it and we’ll take care of it

NHS England has launched GP Access – Tap it, type it and we’ll take care of it, a new multichannel national campaign created by M+C Saatchi Group UK, designed to encourage people to contact their GP practice via its website rather than automatically picking up the phone.

The campaign supports a wider NHS ambition to recover access to primary care by reducing pressure on GP phone lines for those who need them most, particularly during the 8am rush, and by helping patients get the right help in a more convenient way. It focuses on increasing awareness, understanding and use of online forms available through GP practice websites, improving both access and overall patient experience.

At the heart of the campaign is a significant behavioural shift. For many people, the deeply ingrained belief is that the ‘best’ and ‘right’ way to contact a GP is by phone, and that calling is how GP practices want to hear from them. The work is designed to challenge that assumption and create a new memory structure for audiences, reframing online access as an easy, practical way to get help.

With that in mind, the creative needed to connect with a broad range of people while clearly demonstrating the ease and convenience of the service. The campaign centres on everyday members of the public tapping away on laptops and mobiles as they enter their symptoms on their GP practice website. This simple, familiar action is shown in different settings and situations, making the process feel quick, accessible and achievable.As the campaign unfolds, the sound of typing gradually builds into a recognisable rhythm, forming a shared melody that reflects a nation coming together and embracing a new way of accessing care. The edit and tempo begin slowly before building in pace and energy, culminating in a flurry of synchronised tapping. A 30-second film, directed by Simon Ratigan at Rogue Films, brings together sound, picture and emotion to challenge perceptions and, ultimately, help change habits.

title: Happy Valentine’s DA.I.
description:
Agencies:Isla Agency•Rebolucion AI, About Entertainment

The new short film by Rebolucion AI, About Entertainment and creative agency ISLA explores what happens when relationships are no longer altogether human.

Happy Valentine’s DA.I. is a short film developed through a collaboration with Rebolucion AI, About Entertainment, and ISLA. The film reflects how relationships change when technology starts taking over their intimacy.Set in the near future, in an AI-created world, and during Valentine’s Day, its inhabitants feel compelled to express their true feelings.

Ezequiel De Luca and Nicolas Diaco pointed out: “We believe the most insightful way of understanding what AI can contribute to creativity is to put it to the test —not only on a technical level, but also an emotional one. This short film is an excuse to explore new ways of telling stories, incorporating technology as part of the process.”

Happy Valentine’s DA.I. is a short film directed by Sebastian Lopez, developed over a ten-month period and the result of a collaborative work involving Rebolucion, About, and ISLA. It was a cross-team project encompassing conceptual development, scriptwriting, production and post-production. The film was conceived as a non-profit artistic, cultural and experimental piece, and it’s now available on YouTube.

title: chief sleep officer
description:
For years, Bulgarians were told that sleeping is for the weak.In a culture that glorifies exhaustion, rest had a bad reputation.

To challenge that belief, isleep created a job no one had ever heard of: Chief Sleep Officer — and gave it to someone who knows that recovery builds champions: Olympic sprinter Ivet Lalova.

Launched on World Sleep Day, the appointment turned sleep into a national conversation, sparking massive earned media attention across TV, podcasts, social platforms and expert forums.

What started as a symbolic role became a cultural shift — reframing sleep from laziness into strength, and proving that even the strongest need rest to perform.

title: Explore Your Story
description:
Today, Coach introduces “Explore Your Story,” the brand’s Spring 2026 campaign shaped by global listening to Gen Z and co-created with communities worldwide. Spanning cultural partnerships from the United States to China, the campaign features Coach’s iconic Tabby bag and introduces a new collection of readable book charms.

Inspired by a renewed cultural embrace of long-form storytelling, “Explore Your Story” taps into a growing tension: Gen Z lives in a short-form, fast-paced digital world, yet is increasingly turning back to books as a way to explore identity, self-expression and possibility. Through the campaign, Coach champions storytelling as a way to express all of who you are and have the Courage to Be Real, creating room for connection through shared experiences, from books and book clubs to digital communities and campus conversations.

“One of the clearest insights we heard from Gen Z globally is how central storytelling is to how they make sense of who they are and who they’re becoming,” said Joon Silverstein, Coach Chief Marketing Officer. “In a world shaped by fragmentation, digital overload and constant acceleration, many described books and long-form storytelling as a refuge, a way to slow down, reflect and feel a sense of belonging. ‘Explore Your Story’ grew from that insight, and from our desire to show up alongside this generation as they find the confidence to write their own narratives.”

Six boundary-breaking members of the Coach community star in the two films that anchor the campaign. Returning global ambassadors include Academy Award-nominated actress and producer Elle Fanning, Emmy-winning actress and producer Storm Reid, Korean artist, singer-songwriter and producer SOYEON, and Japanese singer-songwriter Lilas Ikuta. They are joined by Paige Bueckers, now in an expanded role with the brand, and breakthrough Chinese singer Shan Yichun, who joins Coach for the first time. Together, they span film, music and sport, each embodying Coach’s grounding purpose: The Courage to Be Real.

Directed by Marcus Ibanez, the two campaign films bring storytelling to life through intimate vignettes that show how a powerful story can shift perspectives, spark possibility and foster community. As each cast member reads a book, the world transforms around her, showing how stories can inspire courage and connection. Each book featured is mirrored by a matching, readable book charm, part of Coach’s new collection, which hangs from each protagonist’s Tabby bag. The films are complemented by still imagery captured by award-winning photographer Elaine Constantine.

title: Everything is Essential
description:
Today, pioneering automotive brand OMODA launches Everything is Essential, a bold new campaign for the OMODA 7 featuring thousands of real flowers, three tons of water and a clowder of live cats. Marking the first work with Uncommon Creative Studio, the campaign signals a confident step into the UK market — showcasing OMODA’s innovation and design through craft-led, culturally fluent storytelling.

Created by Uncommon, the campaign takes a social-first visual approach, pairing distinctive, almost GIF-like visuals with ASMR-inspired sound design. In doing so, it deliberately moves away from the category’s familiar tropes of rugged terrain and high-speed performance, offering a more playful, sensory take on automotive advertising.

The work comprises three striking films, each spotlighting a different element of the OMODA 7’s in-car experience — from intelligent fragrance settings and insulated noise-reducing glass to a 745-mile hybrid range, 14 speakers and 256 light modes.In a world that prizes minimalism — a car packed with this much innovation, technology and unique features is counter cultural. The work leans into this maximalist nature celebrating how everything really is essential to satisfy our human need for more.

EVERYTHING CAPTURED IN-CAMERATogether, the films present the OMODA 7 as a car defined by atmosphere and sensory detail, created for a style-conscious audience. Each execution was captured entirely in-camera placing physical craft at the centre of the storytelling.The first film explores the vehicle’s 745-mile hybrid range in one tank of fuel and charge — brought to life by subjecting the car to every weather condition in the UK you might encounter to show its range. Over the course of the shoot, three tons of water were dropped from ten meters custom-engineered rigs, fans and manual releases, while additional mechanisms generated rain, dust, leaves and snow.

title: Apuesta con los mejores en BetPlay
description:
Dentro de la estrategia de la marca BetPlay, la conexión con figuras deportivas ha sido un pilar importante en la consolidación del liderazgo en el mercado; después de trabajar con grandes deportistas llega un momento clave en la marca, vincular a la compañía al futbolista más grande de la historia del país, James Rodríguez.

Cuando pensamos en James, pensamos en una historia de gloria y también de frustración, pero, detrás de cada momento de celebración y de trabajo en su carrera siempre hubo una constante, el apoyo de un país. James para Colombia representa esa apuesta que nunca falta, esa alegría infinita dada por un talento excepcional y junto a eso, un pueblo que nunca dejó de apostar por él. Así nace apuesta con los mejores, una estrategia de comunicación 360° en la que dimos la gran noticia, ahora James era parte del equipo más grande de Colombia, el equipo BetPlay, y mediante una serie de contenidos en diferentes medios (Televisión, Digital, Radio, OOH, PR, POP) generamos conversación nacional, fortalecimos el vínculo con la marca y dejamos claro que Colombia hoy y siempre seguirá apostando por James en la plataforma de apuestas más grande, BetPlay.

description: For the modern sports fan, a living room is more than a room; it’s a sanctuary of superstition and spirit. title: Calling All Heroes
description: adam&eve\TBWA is proud to unveil “Calling All Heroes,” a bold new campaign created for and in partnership with Merlin Entertainments to celebrate the launch of Galacticoaster, LEGOLAND® Resorts’ newest high-tech indoor rollercoaster coming to LEGOLAND® Florida and LEGOLAND® California Resorts on Feb. 27 and March 6, respectively.Designed to rally heroes of all sizes, the campaign invites families to step up and save LEGOLAND from an out-of-control asteroid in a thrilling mission woven directly into the new ride’s storyline.The campaign spotlights Merlin’s record $90m investment in the groundbreaking space-themed attraction, a first of its kind indoor coaster where guests can design their own spacecraft using LEGO® elements- resulting in more than 625 unique spacecraft combinations- before seeing themselves “riding” in the vehicle they designed before blasting off to face the Asteroid of Probable Destruction heading their way and save LEGOLAND.More a recruitment drive than a traditional advertising campaign, Calling All Heroes serves as a universal call to arms, encouraging families to build, customize, train and save the day together as a crew of LEGOLAND space heroes.The hero launch film, directed by Gary Freedman through MJZ, opens on Mission Control, where Lead space engineer Tex Hardstone and his team have run out of answers for how to stop an asteroid threatening to destroy LEGOLAND. Until an unexpected hero steps forward: 8-year-old Jenny, ready to take charge. As she outlines her imaginative spacecraft vision, the engineers scramble to keep up, racing through LEGO dials, reference books and communication gadgets as Jenny leads the mission through space.The film will run through the end of March, with additional activations planned throughout the year. Versions will air in 60, 30 and 15-second formats across online video, connected TV, radio, social and out of home channels, with campaign media planning and buying led by OMD.Miranda Hipwell, CEO of adam&eve\TBWA, spoke of the creation:“Working with Merlin on our first major campaign post pitch has been a blast from start to finish. What an honor to launch this LEGOLAND work into the stratosphere."Toby Horry, SVP of Global Marketing at Merlin Entertainments, said:“We’re incredibly excited to unveil our new advertising campaign for Galacticoaster, opening at LEGOLAND in Florida and California in the coming weeks. The campaign captures the exhilaration of blasting through space on our newest indoor family coaster while showcasing one of the ride’s most unique features—the chance for every young space explorer to design their very own spacecraft… It’s a perfect example of how families get to build bigger together at LEGOLAND Resorts.”Matt Gay, Executive Creative Director at adam&eve\TBWA, added:“Launch a space ride. At LEGOLAND. An absolute belter of a brief and so much fun to create with our new clients at Merlin Entertainments.”

title: You Are Special
description:
Agencies:72andSunny•BUTTER Music and Sound

The NFL's Inspire Change platform continues its purpose-driven storytelling with You Are Special, a cause spot celebrating the power of feeling seen, valued, and supported.

Inspired by the timeless warmth of Mr. Rogers and created by 72andSunny, with the cover created by BUTTER Music and Sound, the spot features Michael Strahan, Cam Heyward, and Christian McCaffrey alongside children from Harlem Children’s Zone, the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, and SMASH, singing along to the iconic song “You Are Special.” All three organizations are Inspire Change grant partners supported by the NFL.

“You Are Special’ is a powerful expression of what Inspire Change embodies — it’s a reminder to every young person that they matter,” said Sarah Bishop, Vice President of Global Brand and Consumer Marketing for the NFL. “By leveraging the influence of our players to spotlight our incredible Inspire Change partner organizations—and the barriers those partners work tirelessly to break down—this creative builds toward a Super Bowl moment that celebrates community and opportunity for all.”

The campaign has rolled out in multiple versions across key moments of the postseason:A 30-second Inspire Change version launched during Weeks 15 and 16A 60-second general cause version debuted during the NFL’s Christmas Day games and was aired again during the Conference Championship GamesA 30-second general cause version will air during the Super BowlTogether, these placements reflect the NFL Family’s ongoing commitment to investing in youth and communities nationwide, using the league’s biggest moments to spotlight purpose-driven storytelling.

title: Feed the Obsession
description:
Ollie, the human-grade fresh dog food company and leader in the dog wellbeing revolution, introduces today its new brand platform and largest national brand campaign to date, Feed the ObsessionTM. The campaign celebrates the deep, joyful devotion dog parents have for their dogs and Ollie’s obsession with delivering the highest quality experience for parents and pets.

Feed the Obsession is born out of a simple truth: Dog parents are obsessed with their dogs. In fact, according to a recent survey of American dog parents 1, a whopping 89% consider their pup their best friend and more than two-thirds (68%) admit they’d take five years off their own life to add five years to their dog’s. It’s that selfless obsession that fuels Ollie’s team of veterinarians, chefs, food scientists, and tech experts to develop the best possible food, experience, and technology that redefine how we care for our dogs. And in turn, feeds dogs’ obsession with their food.“At Ollie, obsession isn’t a flaw —  it’s our driving force,” said Allison Stadd, CMO of Ollie. “Our veterinarians, engineers, in-house chef, and the rest of our deeply dog-obsessed team use science and technology to build a truly tailored experience, all in service of the one thing that matters most: your dog’s wellbeing. Feed the Obsession puts a flag in the ground. It celebrates the people who read ingredient lists, track poop quality, and reorganize their lives around a dog they love like family, and shows how Ollie fits right into that level of care.”Feed the Obsession features many of the “if you know, you know” habits that make the dog-obsessed a special breed. From perfectly organizing your dog’s food and accessories with custom labels to post-meal mouth kisses and even dedicated dog parent tattoos — the national campaign showcases the tight-knit bond that only humans and their dogs have.

Directed by Josefine Cardoni and created in partnership with creative agency nice&frank, Feed the Obsession launches March 2nd with a series of video spots across streaming platforms like Peacock, Paramount+, and Hulu, as well as broadcast networks like HGTV, The Food Network, NBC, and ESPN — all set to Kylie Minogue’s iconic track, Can’t Get You Out of My Head, which underscores the joyful, obsessive bond between dog parents and their pups.

title: Flexible Pets
description:
Vileda, a global leader in home cleaning, announces the launch of “Flexible Pets”, the new integrated campaign created by Herezie Milano. At the heart of the communication is Flex & Catch, the innovative dust wand featuring a super-flexible head designed to reach even the most difficult corners, making it the ideal ally—especially for pet owners.The creative concept is based on an immediate visual parallel: the ability of dogs and cats to flex and squeeze into tight spaces, just like the new Vileda duster. Through a series of three print subjects, the campaign showcases the extreme flexibility of pets, providing a perfect mirror for the versatility of the new Flex & Catch.To ensure maximum authenticity, the production chose to rely exclusively on the lens of Ale Burset. The award-winning photographer worked without any recourse to AI, seeking the exact moment when the animal’s natural pose perfectly expressed the concept of flexibility.“We wanted the campaign to speak a language of truth. The flexibility of Flex & Catch is real and tangible, just like that of the animals living in our homes,” explained Andrea Stillacci, CEO and President of Herezie. “Relying on Ale Burset allowed us to elevate the product to a superior aesthetic, celebrating nature without filters or technological shortcuts.”The campaign is currently on air in Italy and Eastern Europe. In addition to the print subjects, the communication unfolds across the brand's social channels with a series of video snippets featuring the animal protagonists captured in their most fluid and surprising movements.The ecosystem is further enhanced by influencer marketing activities involving creators and pet owners, invited to test the effectiveness of Flex & Catch against the daily challenges of pet hair and stubborn dust.

title: Vulcanita – Fugglers invade Buenos Aires
description:
To announce the arrival of Fugglers in Argentina, we turned Buenos Aires into the stage for a playful and irreverent FOOH invasion. Together with Vulcanita, we developed a digital film where the brand’s chaotic collectible monsters take over iconic city landmarks, blending humor, surprise, and pop culture at an urban scale.

Fugglers appear roaming through emblematic locations such as the Obelisk and Puerto Madero, interacting with the city as if they truly belonged there. The piece leans into the absurd logic of FOOH content, using visual shock and scale to blur the line between fiction and reality.

Staying true to the characters’ DNA, the film embraces the Fugglers’ most recognizable trait: their provocative, irreverent, and unapologetically crude humor. The result is highly shareable social content designed to entertain first, positioning the brand through laughter and controlled chaos rather than traditional advertising.

title: Lead the Way
description:
Start Your Path is a statewide, multilingual public service campaign designed to address Washington’s urgent behavioral health workforce shortage. Commissioned by the Washington Health Care Authority and developed by Quinn Thomas, the campaign expands awareness of behavioral health careers and guides diverse audiences toward attainable, community-rooted career paths.

Grounded in extensive research, including bilingual focus groups, and community input,  the campaign uncovered a key insight: many young adults and career changers have personal lived experience with mental health or substance use but don’t realize this often-stigmatized experience can qualify them for meaningful roles in the behavioral health field. Confusing education requirements, financial concerns, and fear of emotional strain frequently prevent them from exploring these paths.

Start Your Path reframed what’s possible. Through clear messaging, culturally resonant creative, and low-barrier resources, the campaign demonstrated that impactful healthcare careers can begin with accessible entry-level roles where lived experience is not only valued but essential.

The integrated media approach prioritized authenticity and reach across English- and Spanish-speaking audiences. Key executions included short-form videos, paid search, Reddit conversation ads, transit placements, digital media and DOOH across Washington, sponsored podcast audio, and a guided career quiz on StartYourPath.org.

From September to December 2025, the campaign delivered 14.9 million impressions, 51% above plan, along with 88,000 website sessions and Spanish-language CTRs more than double expectations and industry benchmarks. To date, Start Your Path has generated over 250 million impressions and nearly one million site sessions, offering a scalable model for rebuilding Washington’s behavioral health workforce.

title: Shaping New Futures
description:
On February 1, SALOMON launches Shaping New Futures, its latest global brand campaign, positioning innovation as the brand’s cultural engine: a way to shape sport, influence style, and design a modern mountain sport culture, while staying true to Salomon’s roots.

Over the past three years, SALOMON has followed a clear and purposeful brand trajectory. In 2024, Welcome Back to Earth reaffirmed its deep connection to nature and outdoor culture. In 2025, Invented. ReInvented. extended that vision to the world’s leading cities, showcasing how Salomon’s heritage continually adapts to new environments, practices and communities.

In 2026 Salomon opens new chapter with a campaign dedicated to the mindset that has always set it apart: innovation. Fully asserting its role as a force that shapes both sport and culture.

Guillaume Meyzenq, CEO, Salomon: “2026 marks a significant step in a journey we began in the French Alps 80 years ago.Our mission is to connect people to nature and to shape the future of how the world moves. Whether on a mountain peak or a pavement, we design boldly, ensuring each innovation propels the sport ahead. We are moving from a modern mountain sport equipment brand into a modern mountain sports culture - creating a future where performance & responsibility go hand in hand. "

The new tagline, Shaping New Futures, reflects Salomon’s belief that the future is not something to predict, but something to create. Fueled by curiosity and experimentation, innovation is seen not as a destination, but as an ongoing, unfinished process — driven by bravery, creativity and a constant desire to challenge boundaries.

title: The Case of the Missing Idli
description:
The ChallengeFor most Indians, giving up carbs means giving up comfort.And for millions, that comfort is shaped like a soft, round, perfectly steamed idli.But when fitness fads began villainizing carbs, idlis disappeared from breakfast plates, victims of the new “protein revolution.”

The InsightWhat if we could bring idlis back, not as a cheat meal, but as a smart one?Prolicious launched its new protein-rich idli mix in packaging conceptualised by Creative Khichdi, featuring India’s first front-of-pack nutrition label that proudly puts protein content up front. A bold move that made people see their favourite comfort food in a whole new, guilt-free light.

The IdeaTo launch it, we turned the idli’s disappearance into a national mystery. A dramatic, tongue-in-cheek campaign that began with one simple question: “Where have all the idlis gone?”

The ExecutionWe kicked off with teasers showing idlis vanishing from plates and kitchens across the country. Then came vox pops with real people lamenting their loss, from breakfast lovers to gym-goers trying to cope. Finally, we dropped the big reveal: a breaking-news style launch film announcing that the missing idli had been found, only this time, it came packed with protein.

The OutcomeIndia’s most loved breakfast made a comeback, healthier, happier, and stronger than ever.The campaign sparked conversation, revived nostalgia, and delivered a visible spike in sales for Prolicious’ protein-packed idli range. Because sometimes, to make people fall in love again, you first have to make them miss it.

title: Source FT
description:
In early 2024, thirty6 were asked to help lead a global insight development project to ascertain the core role of the Financial Times within current, lapsed and likely readers, across the globe. The output of this project led to reinforce the FT’s positioning as the most trusted source of quality news, due to its balanced and unbiased approach to reporting – a unique and powerful stance in a news landscape plagued by divided political allegiances and obscured agendas. This then led to the FT and OPC developing SOURCE:FT as the creative articulation of that strategy, with first work in-market in September 2024.

Fast forward a year, with further work in-market back in January, and here we are at the third instalment. The campaign has certainly moved on, stripping back some of the more overt elements that featured at the launch stage, but are no longer needed now that the platform has become more established.

title: The Coffee Run
description:
As anticipation builds for the Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games Milano Cortina 2026 on Feb. 6 and the Big Game on Sunday, Feb. 8, Starbucks is introducing a new ad campaign.

‘The Coffee Run’ ad will debut during the Olympic Winter Games Milano Cortina 2026 opening ceremonies on Feb. 6, with additional placements before and after the Big Game. It will also run on Feb. 8 during the pre-and post-post Super Bowl game.

Starbucks is the Official Coffee Partner of Team USA for the Winter Games, and the ad features Team USA Olympic and Paralympic athletes––including Amber Glenn, Elana Meyers Taylor, Oksana Masters and Aaron Pike.

InspirationA coffee run is simple, yet meaningful universal ritual that inspires connection. It’s more than a quick errand; it’s a gesture of care that strengthens bonds among friends, colleagues, and loved ones, whether shared in a café, at work, or even on the slopes.The campaign reinforces Starbucks role in the rituals that bring people together, from everyday moments to once-in-a-lifetime global events.Details‘The Coffee Run’ reimagines the familiar concept of a coffee run as an epic, cinematic, Olympic-scale journey.The film follows a man on a sweeping journey through a snowy mountain town, zipping through streets on a scooter greeting locals and dropping off Starbucks coffees to members of the Winter Games community and Team USA winter athletes.Along the way, coffee is handed off to members of the extended Team USA community, including Olympic athletes (Elana Meyers Taylor and Amber Glenn) and Paralympic athletes (Oksana Masters and Aaron Pike) and the many people working behind the scenes to support them.Set to a playful, a cappella–inspired track, the film builds in repetition and scale as the runner repeats the journey for one more coffee, ending with a final request at the top of a mountain before cutting to his return to Starbucks, welcomed by a knowing smile from a barista who recognizes him.Highlighting the feeling of warmth and joy when someone brings you a coffee, ‘The Coffee Run’ is a celebration of the dedication, craft, and human connection that goes into every cup, reminding us that a little coffee goes a long way.Directors and Production NotesDirector duo: Julian & QuentinDebuting during one of the busiest advertising moments of the year––Olympics & Super Bowl weekend––a deliberate point of distinction in this film is the analog approach, crafted to feel cinematic rather than commercial, and leading with storytelling.To honor the craft at the heart of The Coffee Run, the film was put through a film out process, transferring the 90-second film to physical film and back introduced texture, grain and imperfection that couldn’t be replicated digitally, grounding the work in the lineage of authentic Italian cinema and giving it a tactile, timeless quality.MusicThe music choice was led by directors Julian & Quentin, who were drawn to iconic American composer Burt Bacharach––famous for his unconventional, highly crafted arrangements.The song “South American Getaway” brings that sense of action and chase that make the film so catchy.

Anomaly is the creative agency that Starbucks partnered with us on the ad campaign.

title: Everyone Deserves a Moonpig
description:
Leading online personalised greeting cards and gifts brand, Moonpig, is launching a special, interactive Valentine’s Day campaign in partnership with Global, the Media & Entertainment Group.

Sharing the love in the run up to February 14th, Moonpig and Heart, the UK's biggest radio brand, have created a co-branded campaign at Tottenham Court Road station, featuring a takeover of every digital screen on the Elizabeth line platforms.

The creative encourages customers to upload an image and message to wish someone special a Happy Valentine’s Day and spread the message that “Everyone Deserves a Moonpig”.

The campaign forms part of Moonpig’s national marketing campaign with Global, which includes radio and online activity across Heart and social media activity on Moonpig’s Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn. It’s a unique and really fun opportunity to celebrate your best mate, your pet, or (more traditionally) the love of your life!

Rachael Halliday, Marketing Director at Moonpig, said: “At Moonpig, we’re all about helping people create more personal, meaningful connections - and is there a better time to share the love than Valentine’s Day? This campaign brings real love stories to life in a fun and joyful way, turning everyday commutes into moments that make you smile. Our Tottenham Court Road takeover celebrates all kinds of love with genuine messages from real people, putting heartfelt connections centre stage. We’re thrilled to be working with Global, the perfect partner to bring these moments to life both on air and on screen.”

title: New, game-changing electric SUV: the Volvo EX60
description:
New, game-changing electric SUV: the Volvo EX60

AKQA and Volvo Cars have continued their creative partnership with the launch campaign for the highly anticipated Volvo EX60. A fully electric SUV that can drive up to 810 km on a single charge.Not only does the EX60 match the range of many petrol cars, it can also fast charge up to 340 km in ten minutes. Being the first of its kind, it’s positioned to overcome the remaining barriers that hold people back from choosing electric – known to consumers as range anxiety. Its innovations not only prove that sustainable travel is no longer a compromise, but mark a new era for electric vehicles.

AKQA, known for pioneering the application of new technology for brands with powerful and impactful storytelling, was proud to be chosen to collaborate with Volvo Cars’ in-house teams to showcase the innovative design and engineering that the EX60 boasts.

The collaboration between Volvo Cars and AKQA ranges from positioning, design system, tease and social assets, to, print, DOOH, digital activations, a “one-shot” film, a series of documentary-styled films, as well as the reveal event, broadcasted live from Sweden.Held at Artipelag, in the Stockholm archipelago on January 21, the reveal brought together industry experts and media for an unexpected live event, where the Volvo record-range SUV was seen driving non-stop on stage. The technological feat was achieved in collaboration with AKQA’s Architecture and interior design practice, Universal Design Studio, FutureDeluxe and Volvo Cars engineers. It required customised sets of robotic, motion-controlled rims, a special-built 26-metre screen, three turntables and a range of meticulously calibrated environments, digitally crafted from Swedish landscapes.Throughout the show, the bespoke content was presented on the surrounding LED screen in sync to the car’s movement, transporting both car and audience to the various environments, demonstrating the EX60’s class-leading capabilities in real time.

The launch campaign continued the theme of uninhibited movement with a “one-shot” film directed by Filip Nilsson and produced by PINE. The film explores the car’s ground-breaking features while celebrating its impressive range as it traverses vast landscapes and dynamic urban environments without a single cut. The film rolled out across social and digital, with shorter formats running on TV. It was accompanied by a suite of other campaign assets, including OOH, DOOH, social and radio.

title: Three cars. One dreamer.
description:
Three stories, one dreamer: Jung von Matt crafts character-led automotive storytelling.

Jung von Matt has developed and produced a global product campaign marking the first major international product push for MINI under its new creative lead agency. Built around a modular storytelling system, the work showcases three distinct vehicles through the imaginative lens of a single, unlikely protagonist, a car wash worker who dreams himself behind the wheel of each MINI model that enters his bay.

The narrative follows a car wash attendant whose daily routine takes a cinematic turn as he begins to fantasize about the lives he might live in each of the three MINI Cooper models he washes. Each vehicle triggers a different story, reflecting the unique personality of the car:

With The MINI Cooper 5-Door, he imagines himself as part of a close-knit band of friends on their way to a gig — laughter, energy, and music filling the car as they cruise through the city.The arrival of The all electric MINI Cooper sparks a joyful family moment, as he sees himself driving through an urban landscape with his daughter beside him.And when The MINI Cooper 3-Door pulls in, he shifts gears into full go-kart mode: tearing through a parking garage with sharp corners, tight turns, and pure driving thrill.Together, these three daydreams form a playful yet powerful expression of the MINI Cooper range. Each model offering a different way to experience the road, and a different version of yourself.

Modular storytelling for global marketsDesigned to meet the complex content needs of markets across three continents, the campaign structure allows for the flexible use of product-led and emotionally driven storytelling elements, while also integrating the witty MINI tone of voice. Although they are unified by a single creative idea, each model narrative can be adapted or expanded to emphasise regional differences.

title: World’s First Music-Streaming Urn
description:
Introducing the first ever music-streaming urn from Liquid Death x Spotify.

Finally death is a lot less boring. With the Eternal Playlist Urn, now the dead can listen to their favorite jams for all of eternity. There are only 150 in existence. Get your own before they are gone forever.

title: 30 Month Aged Fernet
description:
'Tavern Collaborates with Faccia Brutto to Create a One-of-a-Kind Liquor'

To celebrate its third year in business, global creative agency Tavern partnered with its Brooklyn neighbors, Faccia Brutto, to create a one-of-a-kind liquor: a 30-month barrel-aged Fernet Pianta. Fewer than 450 bottles exist. The collaboration brings together two Brooklyn brands and one shared heritage to create something that honors the ritual of Italian drinking traditions.

A collaboration born from Brooklyn craft and friendship

Faccia Brutto has been a long-time collaborator of Tavern. Tavern helped to build the Faccia Brutto brand on the ground – from bar activations to local hype. Its Fernet Pianta is widely considered one of the best Fernets on the market, beloved by bartenders and obsessives alike.

Taking its signature Fernet Pianta, Faccia Brutto placed it in white oak barrels and aged it for 30 months exclusively for Tavern. This is Faccia Brutto’s first-ever aged Fernet, made specifically for this collaboration and never to be reproduced.

title: Burst of Luck
description:
Life’s most treasured moments may not always be picture-perfect. But they are the stories we can laugh about when we come together as a family. Watch what happens when this family is greeted with a ‘burst of luck’ at their reunion dinner!

Wishing everyone a Hay-ppy and prosperous Year of the Horse!

title: A Latte For Every Heart
description:
Created to launch BOH’s new Masala Chai Latte and Cocoa Tea Latte, the video celebrates the beauty of diverse tastes and personalities. Just as people with different interests can live harmoniously, the campaign positions BOH’s new flavours as a reflection of this diversity—distinct yet complementary. Through a light and relatable narrative, the video reinforces BOH’s role in bringing people together, proving that even the most different preferences can share the same cup of connection.

title: Game of Your Life
description:
In “The Game of Your Life,” cyclists and e-bike riders of all ages step into a TV game show where the stakes couldn’t be higher — their own safety. In a studio packed with hidden traps, they ride a giant treadmill, convinced they’re fully in control.But the road — even here — has other plans.

While focusing on a specific task, each contestant faces sudden, unexpected traffic challenges pulled straight from real life. A car door swings open. A pedestrian steps out. Another cyclist appears out of nowhere. Every test mirrors the unpredictability of the streets outside.Because in traffic — just like in this show — confidence can be dangerous.

title: Womance
description:
ConceptCeres, a small Italian beer brand in a world of giants, breaks traditional Italian marketing rules. In a TVC launched for Italy’s most-watched TV event, Sanremo Festival, the brand toasts with what appears to be its most famous competitor— the Green One, as an authentic gesture celebrating friendship beyond differences, because Nobody’s perfect.

Strategic InsightIn a market dominated by major players, Ceres has always stood out for its sincere, irreverent tone. Rather than ignoring competitors, the brand reflects real life: at any party, not everyone drinks the same beer. The campaign turns a potential “mistake” into a message of inclusion and radical tolerance.

The SpotSet to the nostalgic notes of Reality by Richard Sanderson, the film captures the start of an unlikely friendship. At a party, a woman struggles to open her Ceres Strong Ale but is too shy to ask for help. A stranger notices and silently opens it with a spectacular gesture.

This moment sparks a daydream: she imagines a future with her new best friend through surreal claymation scenes. The dream ends abruptly when she sees her friend grab an awkward, “blurred” green beer—you know the one. After a brief pause, acceptance wins. She chooses not to let different tastes get in the way, and they toast anyway. The final scene shows that friendship doesn’t require agreement.

title: The Comeback
description:
BAPTIST HEALTH AND 52. A DREAM COMPANY PRESENT “THE COMEBACK”Baptist Health South Florida, the largest healthcare organization in the region, with 12 hospitals, more than 29,000 employees, 4,500 physicians and 200 outpatient centers, urgent care facilities and physician practices spanning Miami-Dade, Monroe, Broward and Palm Beach counties, together with 52. A Dream Company / Miami, the agency founded and led by Tony Waissmann, present their new work under the concept: “What really matters is living life to the fullest because an injury can take you out of the game, but Baptist Health puts you back in”

Elizabeth Novick Wenger, Director of Brand Management at Baptist Health South Florida, shared her thoughts on the project:

“Seeing Matthew Tkachuk publicly thank our physicians who helped him return to the ice was a powerful reminder of why we do what we do. At Baptist Health, caring for elite athletes and caring for our community are one and the same. It’s about delivering exceptional care with compassion, so every patient can get back to the moments that matter most. 52. A Dream Company, understood that from the very beginning. Their team brought creativity, agility and true partnership to the process, helping us tell this story in a way that feels both authentic and impactful”

Tony Waissmann, Founder & CCO of 52. A Dream Company, commented: The truth is, the first thing I have to say is that it’s a pleasure to work with Baptist Health because of their professionalism and their human quality. This is the first project we’ve done together, and we’re already working on the second. What I find very interesting about this work is that everything is real. We started from a real injury suffered by Matthew Tkachuk, assistant captain and one of the Florida Panthers’ stars, and what happened after his recovery at Baptist Health, when he returned to play and won the Stanley Cup with the team. At that very moment, he thanked the doctors, and everything started from there, leading to this concept, which applies not only to him but to everyone who has a passion for playing a sport or even going for a run. ‘An injury can take you out of the game but Baptist Health, puts you back in.’ It speaks about living life to the fullest, enjoying sports without fear because you know who’s behind you taking care of you. It’s an optimistic message about living and enjoying life.”

title: The Story Of Guests
description:
Ramadan is a season of gathering, where hosting becomes the highlight of every evening. It’s a time when homes open their doors and hospitality takes center stage.

Every family knows the familiar characters who arrive for Iftar or Suhour — the early guest who never misses the call to prayer, the cheerful guest who lifts the mood, the quiet observer who enjoys the moment, and the lively storyteller who keeps the table entertained. Different personalities, different arrivals, yet each one welcomed with the same warmth and generosity.

The Story of Guests celebrates these cherished Ramadan moments — the joy of hosting, the beauty of togetherness, and the spirit of welcoming everyone just as they are.

Inspired by this tradition of heartfelt hospitality, IHG Hotels & Resorts extends the same spirit beyond the home, opening its doors to every guest with warmth, care, and a genuine sense of belonging throughout the holy month.
tags: Ads of the World Highlighted Ramadan Campaigns

title: Uncle Badass
description:
Viettel 5G’s “Uncle Badass,” created by The Friday, reimagines Lunar New Year storytelling by flipping the traditional homecoming narrative. When his family can’t return for Tết, an uncle from northern Vietnam travels across the country to visit them instead. The humour-led road trip captures everyday encounters with drag performers, tattoo artists, gamers, and floating market vendors — communities rarely seen in mainstream holiday ads. By reframing Tết from an act of returning to one of reaching out, the campaign reflects modern Vietnamese family life while showcasing the nationwide connectivity of Viettel 5G in a warm, human way.

title: Outdo It With Intuit Quickbooks
description:
The "Outdo It with Intuit Quickbooks" campaign uses an unexpected but universally recognized cultural icon -- the Tooth Fairy -- to illustrate a familiar small business reality: Running a small business can feel incredibly lonely and overwhelming. Customers consistently say there aren’t enough hours in the day and they wish they could scale themselves.Created by BBDO New York, the campaign asks what the world loses when an essential business owner is pulled away from their work, and shows how QuickBooks helps them continue doing the work that people value and rely on. The work stands apart in a crowded field of AI business tools by approaching both the problem and the solution from the small business owner’s point of view.The message: With Intuit Quickbooks, doing it yourself doesn't mean doing it alone. With a team of AI agents and human experts at your side, customers can outdo financial uncertainty, outdo time constraints, and outdo the competition.This campaign marks a shift from positioning QuickBooks solely as “do-it-yourself” software to offering “done-for-you” experiences. Intuit helps small businesses -- even the Tooth Fairy -- outdo what feels possible.

description:
The film depicts a shredded rendition of a potentially perilous deal that unfolds amidst the chaos of a dimly lit room. title: Got That Right
description:
KAYAK, a leading travel search engine, today unveiled a new brand platform and tagline, “Got That Right,” alongside a new campaign designed to tap into the most stressful moment of travel planning: the decision-making.

While 66% of travelers say booking travel makes them feel stressed, most travel brands continue to focus on selling the thrill of the trip itself. KAYAK is taking a different approach by owning the moment before the trip, when uncertainty and second-guessing peak – and confidence matters most. The new platform positions KAYAK as the tool that cuts through complexity and replaces doubt with confidence, so travelers can book knowing they got it right.

“Our research underscores the reality that travelers don’t need more information, they need reassurance,” said Carolina Montenegro, SVP of Global Brand Marketing at KAYAK.  “As travel search has become increasingly crowded and commoditized and people are bombarded by reels, reviews, stories and more - information overwhelm is real. ‘Got That Right’ is about giving travelers the reassurance that they’ve made the best choice, so they can avoid second-guessing.”

Created in partnership with independent agency Rethink, the campaign is aimed at travelers aged 25-45, dramatizing the very real obstacles standing in the way of booking a trip.

At the center of the effort are two comedic 30-second spots.

title: Never Shop the Same
description:
Today, HomeGoods is unveiling “Never Shop the Same,” a modern evolution of the brand including both a new visual ID and a new campaign. The work is a vibrant invitation back to the way shopping should be—a tactile and visual feast where you can find unique selections of top brands at up to 60% off, curated for people who believe that quality and value are deeply personal.

To reintroduce this "category of one" story, the campaign leans into a strategic musical framework. Each spot uses the music of a global superstar to reinforce HomeGoods’ "IRL" experience:

“We’re reintroducing HomeGoods as an experience that simply can’t be replicated online or in other stores,” says Vanessa  Crooks, VP Director of Marketing at HomeGoods “‘Never Shop the Same’ is a rallying cry to put down the phone, leave task-driven and boring shopping behind, and enjoy discovering something new and different every time you walk through our doors. We’ve modernized the look and feel of the brand to match the premium, ever-changing assortment our customers love.”

“We’ve lost the art of shopping. We shouldn’t be buying pillows and candles on our phones. They’re meant to be touched and smelled," says Leslie Shaffer, CCO at Fallon. "HomeGoods is here to remind everyone of the magic of shopping, and they have an experience like no other. Their inventory changes all the time. They have great quality items at killer prices. It’s not transactional, it’s emotional.”

For the visual identity, HomeGoods is introducing an updated holistic visual style and aesthetics, including a new color palette.

title: "Real Drive"
description:
Bay Area-based independent media and ad agency H/L partnered with Toyota and Palisades Tahoe to deliver a pulse-pounding promo, “Real Drive,” which premiered during the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympic Games and aired during Super Bowl LX across the Northern California region. The spot pairs Olympic gold medalist Jonny Moseley with 15-year-old freestyle moguls skier Beau Rohlen, an aspiring Olympian, to launch the all-new 2026 Toyota RAV4.

“H/L’s latest work in its Toyota/Palisades Tahoe partnership is about meeting this exciting moment with the momentum made by world-class athletes on their sports’ biggest stages, an iconic Northern California destination, and the most advanced RAV4 Toyota has ever built,” said Dallas Baker, Executive Creative Director at H/L.

Toyota, The Official Vehicle of Palisades Tahoe, is captured in motion in high-impact, energetic scenes, slicing through the frame as Rohlen and Moseley take to the resort’s snowy terrain. Conceived by H/L and produced by its integrated in-house production team, Wolfhouse, the fast-paced, action-driven spot captures Palisades Tahoe in pristine bluebird conditions, elevated by bold motion graphics, VFX, dynamic sound design, and music crafted for the biggest stages in sports. The antidote to traditional “car in snow” footage, “Real Drive” starts with accomplished humans doing what they do best and features Toyota’s fully redesigned hybrid 2026 RAV4, reflecting athletic excellence on the slopes.

“Real Drive” leverages Toyota’s partnership with Palisades Tahoe and the US Ski & Snowboard Team to harness the excitement for the Winter Olympics and the NFL in Northern California. Anchoring the film in shots of Rohlen and Moseley in action, cutting down the slopes at Palisades Tahoe, and seeing Toyota vehicles breaking through the frame energetically puts the vehicles on the same playing field as these professional athletes.

“From the moment I saw the boards for ‘Real Drive,’ I knew this campaign was going to be a wild ride,” said Grey Rosado, Senior Editor at Wolfhouse. “The close collaboration between H/L and the Wolfhouse production team—from concept to post—was key to ensuring every dynamic transition and detail landed seamlessly.”

title: Like a Boss
description:
To demonstrate how C Spire powers our connected lives, Lewis created two spots that work as one and ran them back-to-back during the Super Bowl. Together, they depict a fast-paced, energetic day in the life of a connected woman who uses technology to live like a boss.

The spot ran in Mississippi, Birmingham, AL and Nashville, TN across TV, OLV, CTV, Social, Programmatic.
